rules.label: N64: smaller stick deadzone, a rumble pak for every player
rules.notes: Mupen64Plus-Next cuts its own deadzone (default 15%) out of the stick's travel before scaling to the N64's +-80 (emulate_game_controller_via_libretro.c L291-302, libretro.c L838-841 @ mupen64plus-libretro-nx 12edd2c); Steam Input applies a deadzone too, so 5% here. One pak per controller (main.c L1591-1663): rumble means no memory pak.

rules.label: Mario Kart 64: memory pak
rules.notes: The core's ROM database marks it Mempak=Yes (custom/mupen64plus-core/main/mupen64plus.ini.h L9357-9362 @ 12edd2c). The game id is RetroArch's content name [VERIFY] for a .7z.
